minimal_NEW_compressed_contact_reference.definition: For pressure Pstar from the current source, g_c_ref=-Pstar/kn_contact. With finite commonbody port delta_g, U_contact=.5*kn_contact*(g_c_ref+delta_g)^2 per explicitly declared interface measure. Retain plastic/current clocks and original histories.
minimal_NEW_compressed_contact_reference.zero_increment_identity: Preserves source CONTACT spring pressure and energy symbol at zero port increment, subject to original literal rounding enclosure. It does not preserve or transfer old rod stored energy.

once_only_separation_contract.active_reference_energy: Before active contact/bulk integration, declare exactly which source CONTACT spring energy becomes the NEW contact reference energy, which old carriers are historical only, and which physical carrier receives old rod preload/energy. Explicitly enumerate each source carrier once. No all16-area distribution over five cuts, full10km depth, face J, or born HOT interface follows from the source.
once_only_separation_contract.calibrated_NEW_bulk: Current eight common COLD energy laws preserve beam reference energy and tip force, using declared nonlocal full Green strain calibration. Their source reference energy is beam-only. This is not a source-authenticated transfer of old1D rod preload, rest strain, stress field, energy density, or material ownership into new3D bulk.
once_only_separation_contract.current_scope: Read-only accounting audit. No contact law adopted, force solution, full-face/depth distribution, physical rod transfer, whole-clock admission, material advance, or restart certification.
once_only_separation_contract.dissipation: Original cumulative dissipation/work is historical and preserved once; it is not reusable elastic reference energy or newly assigned heat/work.
once_only_separation_contract.historical_archive: Keep all16 original states/labels/areas/plastic/cumulative slip/work/dissipation/clocks and separate old rod/contact stored energies as immutable source accounting. Archived8 donor labels stay present. Their source area remains original1000m interface measure.
once_only_separation_contract.reference_shift: A constant energy-reference offset may be declared for accounting convention, but it does not create source stress, rods-to-bulk material transfer, or correct generalized forces.
once_only_separation_contract.rod_transfer: A physical rod-to-bulk transfer requires an explicit reference/rest-strain or prestress field and material/measure map in the same92body field, its energy/work balance and finite derivatives. The scalar old rod energy alone cannot identify that field or certify its tractions. A constant archive ledger can document history, but cannot certify physical preload or energy transfer.
once_only_separation_contract.unresolved_rod_disposition: Old rods are separate from beam calibration. Therefore retaining only beam-calibrated NEW bulk plus contact-only springs omits old rod stored energy from an active physical state unless an explicit transfer/model change is declared. Conversely adding old rods as an active spring carrier plus a bulk transfer of the same rods would duplicate that source carrier. No actual duplicate has been inferred merely from new bulk and old frozen archive coexistence.

source_definitions.cumulative_work_check: 2e-10 relative tolerance from _validate_state; signed external work equals rods+contact+friction+viscous+numerical dissipation from zero birth
source_definitions.global_accounting: Source _equilibrate_contact_network stored first sums local rod+contact energy increments, then explicitly adds bending_increment. Thus old rods are a separate stored carrier, not part of the beam reference calibration.
source_definitions.local_energy_check: 512*binary64_epsilon relative tolerance; exact F lifts source float literals, with source arithmetic replay separately reported
source_definitions.old_beam: Original K is zero apart from eight cantilever tip diagonals. K_tip=k_beam*R^2. Source global energy=.5*q^T*K*q; physical tip reference sum=.5*k_beam*w_ref^2.
source_definitions.rods: ElasticColumnParameters: kn=1/(Ls/Es+Lo/Eo), kt=1/(Ls/Gs+Lo/Go). Source lengths are along declared fault normal, not radial thickness.
source_definitions.water: water changes friction/cohesion strength only. Compressed normal and elastic shear recoverable energy have no guessed water multiplier. Here water=.7, friction/cohesion/viscosity=0.
